title: Inventory ChatGPT importer parse limits and format detection
findings: Top-level detection is a UTF-8 JSON array only. Filename conversations.json is not sniffed. Official OpenAI help (2026-09-06) documents a ZIP of chat history and does not name conversations.json or a schema.
missing_mapping, missing_content, malformed_author, malformed_content, and node not_object have no dedicated chatgpt.test.ts cases. Drafts are in /work/out/fixtures/.
MAX_RECORD_BYTES (1 MiB) is unused by parseChatGptExport. MAX_RECORDS counts conversations, not messages/nodes. A 256 MiB file with one huge mapping is currently accepted.
Empty array [] is health ok records=0 and enrollable. ZIP bytes are misconfigured malformed JSON, not unzip the export first. A directory is not a regular file: export.
mapping that is an array uses missing_mapping rather than a distinct malformed_mapping code. Non-object author uses malformed_author with reason 'message author is missing'.
bun test of packages/connectors/test/chatgpt.test.ts is NOT_RUN in this archive (missing @kizuki/connector-beeper / node_modules). Do not treat that as PASS.
